subtitleNullable: EXPLORING THE IT EMPLOYMENT MARKET IN HANOI
descriptionNullable: The necessity for labour market knowledge has been brought to light by the Information Technology (IT) industry's rapid growth. Using a dataset of over 2,500 IT job listings gathered from VietnamWorks, ITviec, YBox, TopCV and CareerViet this research examines recruiting patterns in Hanoi. Cleaning, salary normalization, experience extraction, skill standardization, feature engineering, and anomaly detection are examples of data preparation. To determine recruiting trends and labour needs, statistical methodologies, machine learning techniques, and exploratory data analysis are used. The findings show a significant correlation between technical abilities, job experience, and wage levels. The most sought-after talents are SQL, React, and Git, which make up around  19.3%, 18.8%, and 16.5% of all job posts, respectively. Data-related jobs, such as those in data analytics, data science, and data engineering, make up around 9.6 % of the roles that were examined, indicating that demand in this field is rising. The suggested machine learning framework offers trustworthy insights into recruitment dynamics, with the XGBoost classifier achieving an analytical accuracy of 81.27% in experience-tier classification. These results show the value of data-driven approaches for projecting recruiting trends while supporting workforce planning, career development, and curriculum design.
